name: singlet_trajectory_fate_probability
title: Cell-fate probability estimation
description: Estimates each cell's probability of reaching each terminal state, using absorbing Markov chains on a kNN or velocity kernel, or optimal-transport couplings across time points. Needs an embedding or kNN graph plus a root or pseudotime, and optionally terminal states; writes a row-stochastic fate matrix with entropy and argmax. Do not use it as evidence of fate accuracy without outcome data, and do not use waddington_ot without day labels.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: palantir: absorbing chain on a kNN graph; cellrank: multiview kernel absorption; waddington_ot: time-course couplings.

embedding.description: obsm key of the embedding used to build the kNN graph when no graph is stored.

root.description: Start cell: obs column with one TRUE value. Required when obs/pseudotime is absent.

terminal_key.description: uns key listing terminal states; null uses the method's own terminal-state detection.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for Palantir waypoint sampling; default matches Palantir.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

palantir.description: Options used when method is palantir.

knn.description: Neighbours per cell in the kNN graph.

num_waypoints.description: Waypoints for the absorbing chain; cells are lifted to them.

cellrank.description: Options used when method is cellrank.

threshold_scheme.description: Pseudotime edge rule: hard keeps forward edges plus a neighbour fraction; soft is VIA-inspired.

frac_to_keep.description: Fraction of neighbours kept regardless of direction (hard scheme).

tol.description: Relative residual tolerance for the absorption linear solve.

waddington_ot.description: Options used when method is waddington_ot.

time_key.description: obs column with time-point labels; required for this method.

epsilon.description: Entropic regularisation; small values give near-deterministic maps.

lambda1.description: Unbalanced penalty on the source marginal.

lambda2.description: Unbalanced penalty on the target marginal.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: method, terminal_states, waypoints, row_sum_error_max, solver_residual_max. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
